name: clubcal
description: Centralized calendar and scheduling platform for school clubs

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run worker:dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
